anomalies.impact: The touch sensing pin PB5 is shorted to the reset line, and the touch electrode is connected to NRST through R8. This will prevent capacitive touch sensing from working and may cause spurious resets when the pad is touched.

anomalies.expected: With no backup battery in the design, VBAT should be tied to VCC (VDD) per standard STM32L4 practice.
anomalies.impact: Leaving VBAT floating can increase current consumption and cause unreliable operation of the backup domain (RTC, backup registers).

A secondary issue is that the STM32 VBAT pin is left unconnected despite no backup battery being present.
